sources.use: historical Praisos readings and retained evidence images
sources.action: retain exact provenance and component rights
retain attribution/share-alike obligations; never present as critical edition
obtain permission or terms sufficient for systematic structured derivative/public redistribution before ingestion
inspect lawful access terms and obtain permission if systematic structured derivative/public redistribution is not clearly allowed
keep current attributed metadata; assess permission before systematic transcription/image redistribution
seek item identifiers and permission/clear reuse terms before structured object-level ingestion

rule: Access does not equal redistribution permission. Bibliographic facts and attributed summaries do not authorize systematic reproduction of protected editions, images or apparatus.
